set.pl: Vejvoda 80 acres, S½ SE¼ sec. 23 T36N R11W, Town of Bear Lake (Barron Co.), farmstead dot near the SE corner (Hixson plat book, about 1915)
set.t: 1915 plat shows J. Vejvoda's 80 acres in sec. 23, Bear Lake town; the 1925 papers say silver was buried between the road and the house. Search the strip between the road frontage and the old house site near the SE corner; check the 1938 aerial for the house and driveway. Caveat: the plat is 10 years older than the story, and "J." fits John. Private land: permission needed.
